text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Please let Ma-chan join in too!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: That's not fair.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
A long-awaited direct showdown. A few 
much-talked-about girls have joined the 
fray. The hype is through the roof.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Ma-chan also wants to join the 
conversation. So with that said, please 
include Ma-chan."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Forget about mingling... I've got my eyes 
on Chan-chan, you know.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Me too. Naturally.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, is that so?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
It was causing quite a stir on social 
media too, with Aston Machan joining the 
fray and all.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Huh? What? Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"‘Of course I'm looking forward to the 
head-to-head matchup. But there's Marchan 
and many other strong Umamusume too.’"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"It's truly impossible to tell who will 
win; it wouldn't be surprising no matter 
who takes the victory..."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Sheesh, this makes no sense! No matter how 
you look at it, I'm the strongest one 
here~!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? No way! The strongest one is me! 
Daiwa Scarlet!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"...Is that so? To think that I, Machan, 
completely overlooked it."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It is a welcome expectation. And 
expectations must be lived up to.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"If it's a stage where anyone could 
reasonably win, then I shall win in a way 
that makes them say it was only natural."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I will beat both of them. Chan-Me will... 
by a mile.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Leave you in the dust? Sounds great. 
I'm throwing those exact words right back 
at you!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
No need to rush. I'll make sure everyone's 
convinced.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: What are you smiling at, Chan-chan?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
No... I was just thinking that we've 
really become close friends.

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: —Let us create a legend. Together.
